title: S&P Remains Bullish While Tech Weakens, Recession May Loom As Flying Cars Distract From Inflation
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: After Warsh's speech an October hike is nearly ruled out, but a December hike is still a decent chance.
AI capex is the only reason the US isn't officially in recession; a 25% cut could send the economy into a tailspin.
Yields dropped despite hot PPI/CPI because of economic-meltdown fears, credit stress and safe-haven buying.
Weak Kospi rebound suggests more selling next week.

calls.condition: Bullish while SPX holds above ~7575; below the neutral zone turns bearish with a breakdown toward 7,000. Expects a pullback off the orange trend line near 8,000-8,038.
calls.reason: Bullish bias zone held on Thursday's gap down; repeated tests weaken the Aug 13 high so expects a breakout up to a long-term descending/ascending orange trend line near 8,000.
calls.quote: I'm just bullish until at least we achieve that 8,000-ish level.

calls.reason: Expects a retrace to a broken trend line around 100.85, then a bounce of unknown size.
calls.quote: I would continue to expect weaker dollar action into around the 100.85 level on the DXY.

calls.reason: Weekly and daily topping tails at the 2007-high trend line marked a top; yields fell this week.
calls.quote: Daily topping tails, folks, are bearish reversal signals. What happens this week? Boom, right to the downside, yields go.

calls.reason: Growing more bearish on oil near resistance; started a small USO short at Thursday's highs.
calls.quote: I am actually getting a little bit more bearish on oil... I shorted the USO yesterday

calls.reason: Trading in a clear channel; ~393 upper line has rejected repeatedly, short there with a stop just above, buy at the lower line.
calls.quote: if we rally up into this, you know, 393 level, you should have some resistance.

calls.condition: A daily close below the line with a confirmation candle probably sends gold to 3,500.
calls.reason: Gold keeps recapturing the key line without a confirmed breakdown; still 'holding on to the cliff's edge'.
calls.quote: A close below with confirmation, it probably goes to 3,500, but until then... This is still okay.

calls.reason: Confirmed close below support; a rally into that level should be rejected and lead lower.
calls.quote: So now I'm more in the camp of $50 on silver than I would be on 3,500 on gold

calls.condition: A daily close below 81,000 with confirmation targets 75,500.
calls.reason: 81,000 is the key level; dipped below Thursday but was saved.
calls.quote: Breaks of that on a daily closing basis with confirmation, you're headed to 75,500.

notes: Says SPX bullish is short-term only ('not bullish 6 months from now'), so long_term left 'none'. MSFT (watching triple top) and natural gas (holding half long, would re-add lower) not recorded; IONQ/CAT were closed trades.
